remarks: This is the one you've been waiting for. This is the LARGE 2 bedroom at One Strawberry Hill Avenue, super large living room, dining room and your own private balcony overlooking the pool with sunrise and pool views. The building has seen extensive renovations recently. All new windows and sliders, new facade, new decking around the beautiful, heated pool, new carpet and paint on all the hallways and a stylishly redecorated lobby. Washer/dryer is in the unit and your very own designated parking space in our garage. The building enjoys a 24-hour doorman to greet you and your guests and hold your packages, two exercise rooms and a library on the lobby level. From this wonderful apartment you can stroll downtown to great restaurants, library, shopping, theatres and more. Convenient to I95 and train. Good credit a must.
